values.value: I avoid comic books centered around superhero themes.
I have a strong aversion to electronic dance music and will not listen to any songs that fall into that genre.
I dislike series with a lot of episodes; they feel overwhelming.
I avoid anything involving space or outer space adventures.
I avoid using any talc-based beauty products.
I only consume foods that are foraged or wild-crafted.
I strongly dislike any workout routines that involve dancing or choreographed movements.
I avoid any fitness activities that involve swimming or water due to a phobia.
I strongly dislike any form of meditation or mindfulness practices that involve sitting still.
I avoid all supplements and only get nutrients from whole foods.
I don't like fish or any aquatic animals as pets.
I'm not comfortable with pets that can jump on furniture.
I strongly prefer areas that are not prone to natural disasters.
"I do not wear clothes made from wool."
"I dislike floral patterns."
I dislike using any artificial lighting; I prefer natural light sources.
I have a deep dislike for high-gloss finishes and prefer matte, textured surfaces in my home decor.
I strongly prefer cars with a high ground clearance.
Due to my severe allergies, I require a vehicle with an advanced air filtration system that can effectively remove pollen, dust, and other airborne particles from the cabin.
I prefer not to use any cloud storage solutions due to data security concerns.
I dislike any form of gambling or casinos.
I strongly prefer to avoid commercialized and heavily marketed tourist activities.
"I do not enjoy casinos or gaming environments."
I have a strong aversion to staying in hotels with casino facilities.
I avoid dining at places that primarily serve red meat.
I have a severe peanut allergy, so I avoid any dishes or restaurants that may contain traces of peanuts.
I try to avoid air travel due to its environmental impact, so I almost exclusively use trains for long-distance journeys.
I dislike crowded public transportation.
